per_candidate.id: s2:Spectral Hardness and Evolution of Swift Gamma-Ray Bursts and X-Ray Afterglows

rationale: Paper 2509.02769 directly investigates the nature of the afterglow plateau emission in a specific GRB, providing evidence that challenges the central engine activity explanation and supports an off-axis jet model. This contributes substantive new evidence but does not fully settle the broader question for all GRBs.
